definitions.explanation: A female parent. More formal or objective than {母|はは} (my mother) or お{母|かあ}さん.

examples.japanese: {母親|ははおや}として{責任|せきにん}を{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel responsibility as a mother.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{母親|ははおや}は{教師|きょうし}だ。
{母親|ははおや}の{愛情|あいじょう}は{深|ふか}い。

notes:
USAGE: {母親|ははおや} is a neutral/objective term for 'mother.' It's used when discussing mothers in general or referring to someone else's mother in a neutral way.

FAMILY TERM COMPARISON:
・{母|はは} - my mother (humble, when speaking to others)
・{母親|ははおや} - mother (neutral, objective)
・お{母|かあ}さん - mother, mom (familiar, can be used for others' mothers too)
・ママ - mommy (casual)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{母親|ははおや}として (as a mother)
・{母親|ははおや}の{愛|あい} (mother's love)
・{片|かた}{親|おや} (single parent)
・{実|じつ}の{母親|ははおや} (biological mother)

ANTONYM:
・{父親|ちちおや} (father)
